thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Reaffirmed by Deutsche Bank

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Reaffirmed by Deutsche Bank
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Apr 18th, 2018 // No Comments 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s stock had its “hold” rating reaffirmed by equities researchers at Deutsche Bank in a report issued on Wednesday, July 12th. 
A number of other equities analysts have also weighed in on the company. Royal Bank of Canada increased their target price on Apple from $157.00 to $168.00 and gave the stock an “outperform” rating in a research note on Monday, May 22nd. Rosenblatt Securities set a $120.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “hold” rating in a research note on Wednesday, May 3rd. Canaccord Genuity restated a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, July 10th. Goldman Sachs restated a “buy” rating and set a $170.00 price objective (up previously from $164.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, May 12th. Finally, Vetr upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $146.43 price objective on the stock in a research note on Monday, March 27th. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $203.21. 
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL traded down $0.40 during trading hours on Wednesday, reaching $177.84. 20,538,125 shares of the stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 35,979,844. The firm has a market cap of $892,113.06, a P/E ratio of 19.31, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a 52 week low of $140.45 and a 52 week high of $183.50. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $3.36 earnings per share. analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current year. 
In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, April 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 66,191 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders. 
Hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently added to or reduced their stakes in the stock. Fusion Family Wealth LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter worth approximately $1,115,000. Artisan Partners Limited Partnership increased its holdings in Apple by 5.0% during the 4th quarter. Artisan Partners Limited Partnership now owns 420,128 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $48,659,000 after purchasing an additional 19,845 shares in the last quarter. Cleararc Capital Inc. increased its holdings in Apple by 9.0% during the 4th quarter. Cleararc Capital Inc. now owns 151,235 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $17,516,000 after purchasing an additional 12,534 shares in the last quarter. State Street Corp increased its holdings in Apple by 2.0% during the 4th quarter. State Street Corp now owns 219,739,579 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $25,450,260,000 after purchasing an additional 4,301,005 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Peregrine Asset Advisers Inc. increased its holdings in Apple by 6.7% during the 4th quarter. Peregrine Asset Advisers Inc. now owns 13,806 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,599,000 after purchasing an additional 865 shares in the last quarter. 61.35% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.

Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
